cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To get your sofa off the ceiling, turn the gravity dial politely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm losing my deposit. How do I turn politely?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cover the deposit. Pause at each number; they dislike being passed over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six clicked, but now the armchairs are rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six has invited witnesses. I'll stand with you; apologise to the whole suite.
